member.name: M:Meziantou.Framework.Scheduling.CronExpression.GetNextOccurrences(System.DateTime,System.TimeZoneInfo)
member.summary: Gets all occurrences of the expression, reading as a wall-clock time in .
member.param: The wall-clock time to start generating occurrences from. Its is ignored.
The time zone the expression is evaluated in.
member.returns: An enumerable sequence of occurrences, each carrying the UTC offset in effect at that occurrence.

remarks.para: The occurrences keep their wall-clock time across a daylight saving transition, so their UTC offset changes. A local time made invalid or ambiguous by a transition is resolved as RFC 5545 section 3.3.5 requires: an ambiguous time keeps its first occurrence, and an invalid time is read with the UTC offset in effect before the gap.
As a consequence, an hourly expression repeats an instant across a forward transition and skips the instants of the repeated hour across a backward one.

member.name: M:Meziantou.Framework.Scheduling.CronExpression.GetNextOccurrences(System.DateTimeOffset,System.TimeZoneInfo)
member.summary: Gets all occurrences of the expression, starting from the instant denotes.
member.param: The instant to start generating occurrences from. It is reduced to a wall-clock time in .
The time zone the expression is evaluated in.
member.returns: An enumerable sequence of occurrences, each carrying the UTC offset in effect at that occurrence.
member.remarks: Reducing an instant to a wall-clock time is lossy in the hour repeated by a backward transition, where both readings denote the same wall clock. Use the overload to control which one is meant.

member.name: T:Meziantou.Framework.Scheduling.RecurrenceRule
member.summary: Represents a recurrence rule as defined in RFC 5545 for recurring events.

remarks.para: Supports the following RFC 5545 recurrence rule properties:

item.description: FREQ (Secondly, Minutely, Hourly, Daily, Weekly, Monthly, Yearly)
UNTIL - End date for the recurrence
WKST - The day on which the workweek starts
BYSECOND - Limits occurrences to specific seconds (0-60; 60 denotes a leap second and is normalized to 59)
BYMINUTE - Limits occurrences to specific minutes (0-59)
BYHOUR - Limits occurrences to specific hours (0-23)
BYDAY - Limits occurrences to specific days of the week
BYMONTHDAY - Limits occurrences to specific days of the month (1-31, -1 to -31)
BYYEARDAY - Limits occurrences to specific days of the year (1-366, -1 to -366)
BYMONTH - Limits occurrences to specific months (1-12)
BYSETPOS - Limits occurrences to specific positions in the recurrence set

member.name: M:Meziantou.Framework.Scheduling.Utilities.IsDuplicate(System.Nullable{System.DateTime},System.DateTimeOffset)
member.summary: RFC 5545 section 3.8.5.3: duplicate instances are ignored.

remarks.para: Every local time in the gap of a forward transition is read at the UTC offset in effect before the gap, which maps the whole gap onto the instants the hour after it also denotes. A sub-hourly recurrence therefore repeats a run of instants, and the repeats are neither adjacent to nor ordered after the instances they duplicate.

Keeping only what is strictly after the last instant produced removes every such repeat, and leaves the recurrence set increasing. The duplicate and the instance it repeats convert to the very same value, so which of the two is kept does not matter.
